main_body: Brick range with a dark slate hood, a metal vent band and a brick base with a glowing firebox, under a brick chimney stack
top_band: rows 20-21 light grey-mauve (L~120) is a thin sloped hood edge, then dark slate rows 22-25 (L~61); no real horizontal top surface
evidence: The column at x=16 shows a 2-row light band (rows 20-21) and then a dark hood face (rows 22-26). That is a hat-like eave, not a top surface seen from above. Below it the vent band (rows 28-35), the brick base and the firebox (rows 37-44) are all flat vertical faces, drawn as a straight front view. The firebox is inset with a dark frame, and the hood does cast an eave shadow. The chimney is also a flat front brick wall. No band reads as a horizontal surface, so the piece is a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The candidate has 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Its median of 13 colours per tile is close to the references (17 and 20), and flat-fill coverage is 0%. The dark edge pixels are 98% near-neutral, so the outline is a neutral black/grey line, unlike the tinted material outlines of the references (1% and 33%). That is the sticker look. The brick and fire have some texture, but the slate hood and the metal band are plain, with few shading steps.
